1) PO: Please use PO# MS-2026-2109 for the final invoice.
2) Payment format: AP prefers a single net invoice if possible — it simplifies matching. If you must issue a credit memo, send both documents in the same envelope and reference the PO.

I’m copying AP Finance so they see the PO and can confirm acceptance timeframe (standard net 45 for our account).
